brake_fraction.interpretation: Observed matched-cohort pedal use; not intention, causality, pace superiority or a car-independent driver signature.
brake_fraction.reason: The Bonferroni-adjusted interval includes zero or cannot be estimated; a direction is not established.

coast_fraction.interpretation: Observed matched-cohort pedal use; not intention, causality, pace superiority or a car-independent driver signature.
coast_fraction.reason: The family-wise interval excludes zero and the direction survives the declared available sensitivities and every leave-one-race-out estimate.

full_throttle_fraction.interpretation: Observed matched-cohort pedal use; not intention, causality, pace superiority or a car-independent driver signature.
full_throttle_fraction.reason: The Bonferroni-adjusted interval includes zero or cannot be estimated; a direction is not established.

limitations: Race matching controls only recorded context; fuel,setup,weather,traffic,instructions and within-bin differences can remain.
Equal-cell and equal-race weights describe common support,not the time fraction over the whole season.
Bootstrap races are observational blocks,not randomized assignments; few races and selective source coverage limit inference.
The three primary intervals use Bonferroni correction; sensitivities are robustness checks rather than searches for significance.
No human atlas validation,no driver intention or causal championship explanation is established.

metric_definitions.brake_fraction: Native valid-time fraction with binary brake applied
metric_definitions.coast_fraction: Native valid-time fraction with throttle<=5 percent,brake off,speed>=80 km/h
metric_definitions.full_throttle_fraction: Native valid-time fraction with throttle>=98 percent
